Orders.definition: All source-status orders in the current purchase-date and geography context.

Eligible Delivered.definition: Delivered orders with valid actual/promise dates and nonnegative total delivery duration.

Late Orders.definition: Actual delivery calendar date is after the estimated calendar date; eligible delivered orders only.

On-time Delivery.definition: On-time eligible deliveries divided by eligible delivered orders. Zero denominator returns blank.

Late Rate.definition: Late orders divided by eligible delivered orders.

Median Delivery Days.definition: Median elapsed purchase-to-delivery days; invalid outcomes are blank.

P90 Delivery Days.definition: 90th percentile elapsed days among eligible delivered orders; blanks excluded.

Average Review.definition: One latest selected valid review per order; reviewed orders only, including all statuses.

Reviewed Orders.definition: Orders with a selected review score.

Review Coverage.definition: Selected-review coverage across all selected orders.

Low Rating Rate.definition: Low selected reviews divided by reviewed orders.

Post-delivery Reviews.definition: Selected reviews answered on/after delivery, within eligible delivered orders.

Post-delivery Low Rating.dax: DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Low Reviews],REMOVEFILTERS('Order'[Review Score]),'Order'[Delivery Eligible]=1,'Order'[Post Delivery Review]=1),CALCULATE([Post-delivery Reviews],REMOVEFILTERS('Order'[Review Score])))
Post-delivery Low Rating.definition: Low-rating share of the full delay-band post-delivery sample, unaffected by hovered score segment. Descriptive, not causal.

Post-delivery Band Reviews.definition: Full delay-band post-delivery sample size; ignores the hovered score segment.

Post-delivery Coverage.definition: Post-delivery selected responses divided by eligible orders in the delay band; ignores score segment.

Review Timing Note.dax: VAR LateCoverage = CALCULATE([Post-delivery Coverage],REMOVEFILTERS('Order'[Delay Band],'Order'[Review Score]),'Order'[Is Late]=1) VAR OnCoverage = CALCULATE([Post-delivery Coverage],REMOVEFILTERS('Order'[Delay Band],'Order'[Review Score]),'Order'[Is Late]=0) RETURN "Post-delivery coverage: late " & IF(ISBLANK(LateCoverage),"n/a",FORMAT(LateCoverage,"0.0%")) & " | on time " & IF(ISBLANK(OnCoverage),"n/a",FORMAT(OnCoverage,"0.0%")) & " | selected responses; not causal"
Review Timing Note.definition: Dynamic coverage warning retains date/state selections; prevents presenting the selected survey sample as representative.

Delivered Merchandise BRL.definition: Item prices once per delivered order. Excludes freight; not profit or recognized net revenue.

Delivered Freight BRL.definition: Freight charges on delivered orders; not logistics costs.

Freight to Merchandise.definition: Ratio of sums over the same delivered-order population.

Late Order Exposure BRL.definition: Merchandise value of late eligible orders; exposure, not lost revenue.

Delivery Exclusions.definition: Delivered-status orders excluded because required actual/promise dates or total chronology are invalid.

State Priority Flag.definition: Top eight ranks by late-order count with at least 100 eligible orders.

Category Eligible.definition: Single-category eligible delivered orders; other categories are not attributed to a dominant product.

Category Priority Flag.definition: Top eight late-count ranks among category segments, with at least 100 eligible orders.

Seller Eligible.definition: Single-seller eligible orders only; no attribution of a multi-seller delay to one seller.

Seller Late Rate.definition: Late rate among single-seller eligible orders.

Seller Priority Flag.definition: Top eight late-count ranks among sellers with at least 100 eligible orders.

Seller Coverage.definition: Share of eligible orders that can be attributed to a single seller.

Median Handoff Days.definition: Median approval-to-handoff elapsed days on valid stages; eligible delivered orders.

Median Transit Days.definition: Median carrier-to-customer elapsed days on valid stages; eligible delivered orders.

Median Stage Days.dax: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Stage'[Stage Order]),1,CALCULATE(MEDIAN('Order'[Approval Days]),'Order'[Delivery Eligible]=1),2,[Median Handoff Days],3,[Median Transit Days])
Median Stage Days.definition: Stage medians use stage-specific valid records and are not additive.

Valid Stage Orders.definition: Stage-specific valid sample size among eligible delivered orders.
